title: —ET TU CUM JESU GALILAEO ERAS
html_source: “And you were with Jesus of Galilee”

anchor.prefix:
er voice, frail and high as a boy’s, was heard intoning from a distant choir the first words of a woman which pierce the gloom and clamour of the first chanting of the passion:

 —
anchor.suffix:
.

 And all hearts were touched and turned to her voice, shining like a young star, shining clearer as the voice intoned the proparoxyton and more faintly as the cadence died.

 Th
anchor.canonical_text: Et tu cum Jesu Galilæo eras
